chunks: We were told by Ibrahim bin Harun al-‘Absi, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Muhammad ibn Sa’eed, that he said: We were told by Ja’far bin Abdullah, that he said: We were told by Kathir bin ‘Ayyash, from Abu’l-Jarud, that he said: I asked Abu Ja’far, al-Baqir (peace be upon him)

By what is the Imam recognized? He said: With certain characteristics, of which the first is an affirmation from Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, for him and His assignment of him as a Banner for the people that there might be an argument upon them, because the Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, assigned Ali (peace be upon him), and made the people know him with his name, and he appointed him. So are the Imams (peace be upon them); the first assigns the second. Moreover, it is that he is asked, and answers, and that it is silent about him, to which he takes initiative, and that he informs people of what is to happen tomorrow, and that he speaks to people in every tongue and language.

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: The Imam, the divinely appointed leader
key_terms.حُجَّةٌ: Proof or argument upon the people
key_terms.نَصْبٌ: Assignment or elevation to a position of authority
key_terms.يَسْكُتُ عَنْهُ فَيَبْتَدِئَ: He remains silent then takes the initiative (to speak or act)

ai.seo_question: What are the key signs and characteristics that identify the Imam according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* articulates the Shia doctrine of *al-Nasb al-I'tibari* (exemplary designation), where the Imam is publicly established as a clear proof (*hujjah*) for humanity, mirroring the Prophet's explicit appointment of Ali ibn Abi Talib. It highlights the Imam's multifaceted authority through his ability to answer inquiries, initiate discourse, predict future events, and communicate in all languages, ensuring his guidance is accessible and undeniable to all people.
